episodes.title: The Vixen and the Beast
episodes.summary: Royal Concubine Kang Dan-sim is sentenced to death by poison. But when she wakes, she finds herself in a very different place: modern-day Korea.

episodes.title: A Guide to Optimizing Your Fate
episodes.summary: As Dan-sim tries to adapt to the new world, her strange ways attract the attention of chaebol heir Cha Se-gye — who approaches her with a proposal.

episodes.title: A Whole New Reality
episodes.summary: Se-gye finds he can't stop thinking about Shin Seo-ri — especially after a weird dream sparks some foreign emotions within him.

episodes.title: Beyond Understanding
episodes.summary: Dan-sim learns more about Seo-ri's past. As Se-gye and Seo-ri spend more time together, mixed signals push them to put their feelings to the test.

episodes.title: Forbidden Fruit
episodes.summary: Confused by Seo-ri's mind games, Se-gye pulls out all the stops to win her heart. Later, Seo-ri deals with a pesky co-star & politics on set.

episodes.title: One Magical Night
episodes.summary: Seo-ri & Se-gye fly out to Jeju, but an emergency leaves Se-gye rattled. Later, Seo-ri goes missing & a worried Se-gye heads out in search of her.

episodes.title: The Dark Side of the Moon
episodes.summary: Seo-ri's feelings for Se-gye grow, but she starts having doubts when Mo Tae-hee stakes her claim on Se-gye as well. Suddenly, Se-gye runs into trouble.

episodes.title: Screw This World
episodes.summary: Tae-hee announces her engagement to Se-gye to the press, angering Se-gye and fueling Seo-ri's jealousy. Choi Mun-do threatens Seo-ri with a demand.

episodes.title: That's First Love for You
episodes.summary: Se-gye confronts Seo-ri about her identity — who is Dan-sim? Forced to face her past, Seo-ri makes up her mind about her relationship with Se-gye.

episodes.title: Hope, Despair, and Longing
episodes.summary: With the link between Seo-ri and Dan-sim revealed, Se-gye and Dan-sim make things official. A furious Mun-do goes to extreme lengths to take revenge.

episodes.title: What Lies on the Hidden Path
episodes.summary: Dan-sim wakes to find herself back in the Joseon era. While she tries to return to the present, Se-gye deals with the fallout from Mun-do's scheming.

episodes.title: Reclaiming Lost Time
episodes.summary: Dan-sim and Seo-ri's worlds start to collide. Se-gye takes Dan-sim to meet someone important to him, but she reveals that they're running out of time.
